impact: Gate run 3 was killed by SIGTERM mid-root-full (cargo exit 143, 0 suites executed) and verify.sh itself died before writing its summary — no exit file, though desktop.log shows that stage had already passed 439 tests. summary: pkill -f verify.sh is not agent-scoped on a shared box: stopping your own void gate run stops every sibling's too

caught_by: git diff --stat 64e946cb origin/tranche/9 before deciding whether the merge needed a re-gate, rather than reading the commit subject
gap: A commit subject naming a receipt is not evidence that the commit is docs-only. §46.6 rule 2 says a gate spanning a merge is void; it does not say how to tell whether a merge matters, and the cheap answer is the diffstat.
summary: A 'receipt' commit carried two gate-covered files; the diffstat is what distinguishes a merge that needs a re-gate from one that does not
